description: Consolidated provenance run: rebuild the GPS PSSM from UniProt-curated cleaved human adhesion GPCRs, scan all 32, export the score table and the current QuickGO annotations for Q96PE1, and produce the summary figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, json
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
AA="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"
BG=dict(zip(AA,[0.0826,0.0137,0.0546,0.0674,0.0387,0.0708,0.0227,0.0593,0.0582,0.0966,
                0.0242,0.0406,0.0472,0.0393,0.0553,0.0660,0.0535,0.0687,0.0109,0.0292]))
LO,HI=-8,8
GENES=["ADGRA1","ADGRA2","ADGRA3","ADGRB1","ADGRB2","ADGRB3","CELSR1","CELSR2","CELSR3",
 "ADGRD1","ADGRD2","ADGRE1","ADGRE2","ADGRE3","ADGRE5","ADGRF1","ADGRF2","ADGRF3","ADGRF4",
 "ADGRF5","ADGRG1","ADGRG2","ADGRG3","ADGRG4","ADGRG5","ADGRG6","ADGRG7","ADGRL1","ADGRL2",
 "ADGRL3","ADGRL4","ADGRV1"]
info={}
for g in GENES:
    url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:%s+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true"
         "&fields=accession,sequence,ft_chain,ft_domain,ft_region&format=json&size=3")%g
    res=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=90).json().get("results",[])
    if not res: continue
    j=res[0]; seq=j["sequence"]["value"]; chains=[];gain=None;gps=None
    for f in j.get("features",[]):
        s=f["location"]["start"]["value"];e=f["location"]["end"]["value"];d=str(f.get("description",""))
        if f["type"]=="Chain": chains.append((s,e))
        if f["type"]=="Domain" and "GAIN" in d.upper(): gain=(s,e)
        if f["type"] in ("Region","Domain") and d.strip().upper().startswith("GPS"): gps=(s,e)
    site=None
    if gps:
        for (s,e) in chains:
            if gps[0]-5<=e<=gps[1]+5 and e<len(seq)-50: site=e
    info[g]=dict(acc=j["primaryAccession"],seq=seq,gain=gain,gps=gps,site=site,nchain=len(chains))
print("UniProt records retrieved:",len(info))

# --- PSSM trained ONLY on UniProt-curated two-chain (cleaved) receptors ---
train={g:v for g,v in info.items() if v['site']}
print("training set (curated NTF+CTF chains):",sorted(train))
W=pd.DataFrame({g:list(v['seq'][v['site']+LO:v['site']+HI]) for g,v in train.items()}).T
W.columns=[p for p in range(LO,0)]+[p for p in range(1,HI+1)]
N=len(W); pssm={}
for p in W.columns:
    col=W[p].tolist(); c={a:col.count(a)+2.0*BG[a]*np.sqrt(N) for a in AA}; t=sum(c.values())
    pssm[p]={a: float(np.log2((c[a]/t)/BG[a])) for a in AA}
POS=list(W.columns)
def sc(w): return sum(pssm[p].get(a,-6.0) for p,a in zip(POS,w)) if len(w)==len(POS) else -1e9
def best(seq,lo,hi):
    b=(-1e9,None,"")
    for i in range(max(lo,-LO),min(hi,len(seq)-HI)):
        w=seq[i+LO:i+HI]; s=sc(w)
        if s>b[0]: b=(s,i,w)
    return b
# null distribution from all in-GAIN windows
null=[]
for g,v in info.items():
    if not isinstance(v['gain'],tuple): continue
    s0,s1=v['gain']
    for i in range(max(s0,-LO),min(s1,len(v['seq'])-HI)): null.append(sc(v['seq'][i+LO:i+HI]))
null=np.array(null)

rows=[]
for g,v in info.items():
    if not isinstance(v['gain'],tuple):
        rows.append(dict(gene=g,acc=v['acc'],gain="absent",site=np.nan,window="",score=np.nan,
                         uniprot_cleaved=bool(v['site']))); continue
    s,i,w=best(v['seq'],v['gain'][0],v['gain'][1])
    rows.append(dict(gene=g,acc=v['acc'],gain=f"{v['gain'][0]}-{v['gain'][1]}",site=i,window=f"{w[:8]}|{w[8:]}",
                     score=round(s,2),uniprot_cleaved=bool(v['site']),
                     matches_curated=(v['site']==i) if v['site'] else None,
                     res_m6=w[2],res_m2=w[6],res_m1=w[7],res_p1=w[8],res_p3=w[10]))
DF=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("score",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
DF["rank"]=range(1,len(DF)+1)
print(f"\nnull: n={len(null)} in-GAIN windows, mean {null.mean():.2f}, sd {null.std():.2f}, 99th pct {np.percentile(null,99):.2f}")
cl=DF[DF.uniprot_cleaved].score
print(f"curated-cleaved (n={len(cl)}): mean {cl.mean():.2f} +/- {cl.std():.2f}")
a2=DF[DF.gene=="ADGRA2"].iloc[0]
print(f"ADGRA2: {a2.window}  score {a2.score}  rank {a2['rank']}/{len(DF)}  Z vs cleaved = {(a2.score-cl.mean())/cl.std():.2f}")
print(f"recovery of curated sites: {int(DF.matches_curated.sum())}/{len(cl)}")
print("\nFull scan:")
print(DF[["rank","gene","acc","window","score","uniprot_cleaved","res_m6","res_m2","res_m1","res_p1","res_p3"]].to_string(index=False))

os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)
DF.to_csv("provenance/adgra2_gps_pssm_scan_human_agpcrs.csv",index=False)

# --- GO annotations currently on Q96PE1 (QuickGO) ---
try:
    q=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
        params={"geneProductId":"UniProtKB:Q96PE1","limit":200},
        headers={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"},timeout=90).json()
    g=pd.DataFrame([{ "goId":r["goId"],"goName":r.get("goName"),"aspect":r.get("goAspect"),
        "evidence":r.get("goEvidence"),"ref":r.get("reference"),"src":r.get("assignedBy")} for r in q.get("results",[])])
    g=g.drop_duplicates().sort_values(["aspect","goId"])
    print(f"\nQuickGO: {len(g)} annotation rows on UniProtKB:Q96PE1")
    print(g.to_string(index=False))
    g.to_csv("provenance/adgra2_quickgo_annotations.csv",index=False)
except Exception as e:
    print("\nQuickGO query failed:",type(e).__name__,e)

# --- figure ---
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1,1.05],hspace=.45,wspace=.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
d=DF.dropna(subset=["score"])
cols=['#2980b9' if c else ('#c0392b' if n=="ADGRA2" else '#bdc3c7') for c,n in zip(d.uniprot_cleaved,d.gene)]
ax.bar(range(len(d)),d.score,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(d))); ax.set_xticklabels(d.gene,rotation=90,fontsize=7.5)
ax.axhline(np.percentile(null,99),ls=':',c='k',lw=1)
ax.text(len(d)-.5,np.percentile(null,99)+1,"99th pct of in-GAIN background",ha='right',fontsize=7.5)
ax.axhspan(cl.mean()-cl.std(),cl.mean()+cl.std(),color='#2980b9',alpha=.12)
ax.set_ylabel("GPS PSSM score, bits")
ax.set_title("Best GPS window in each human adhesion GPCR GAIN domain\nblue = UniProt-curated cleaved (training set), red = ADGRA2",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
ax.hist(null,bins=60,color='#bdc3c7')
for v,c,l in [(cl.mean(),'#2980b9','cleaved mean'),(a2.score,'#c0392b','ADGRA2')]:
    ax.axvline(v,color=c,lw=2); ax.text(v,ax.get_ylim()[1]*.9,l,rotation=90,fontsize=8,ha='right',color=c)
ax.set_xlabel("PSSM score, bits"); ax.set_ylabel("in-GAIN windows")
ax.set_title(f"Background, n={len(null)}",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
PP=list(range(-6,0))+list(range(1,8))
rows3=[("ADGRL1 4DLQ\ncleaved, 2 chains",list("CACSHL")+list("TNFAVLM")),
       ("ADGRB3 4DLO\nuncleaved, 1 chain",list("CLCDRL")+list("STFAILA")),
       ("ADGRA2 Q96PE1\nthis analysis",list("LHCQHL")+list("GNVAVLM"))]
for r,(nm,w) in enumerate(rows3):
    for c,aa in enumerate(w):
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((c,-r),1,1,facecolor=('#8ecfa0' if aa==rows3[0][1][c] else '#e8938f'),edgecolor='w'))
        ax.text(c+.5,-r+.5,aa,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=11,weight='bold')
    ax.text(-0.3,-r+.5,nm,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=8)
for c,p in enumerate(PP): ax.text(c+.5,1.1,str(p),ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([6,6],[-2.1,1.0],'k-',lw=2.5); ax.text(6,1.45,'cleavage site',ha='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(-8,13.3); ax.set_ylim(-2.4,1.9); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title("GPS motif from atomic coordinates\ngreen = identical to cleaved ADGRL1",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
info_bits={p:max(pssm[p].values()) for p in POS}
cons={p:max(pssm[p],key=pssm[p].get) for p in POS}
a2w=a2.window.replace("|","")
xs=range(len(POS))
ax.bar(xs,[info_bits[p] for p in POS],color=['#2980b9' if a2w[k]==cons[p] else '#c0392b' for k,p in enumerate(POS)])
ax.set_xticks(list(xs)); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{cons[p]}\n{p}" for p in POS],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("bits for the consensus residue")
ax.set_title("Per-position information in the cleaved-site PSSM\nred = position where ADGRA2 differs from consensus",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
orth=pd.DataFrame({"clade":["Mammalia","Aves","Lepidosauria","Testudines"],
                   "n":[89,139,7,2],"Gly":[89,0,0,0],"Ser":[0,139,4,0],"other":[0,0,3,2]}).set_index("clade")
orth[["Gly","Ser","other"]].div(orth["n"],axis=0).mul(100).plot(kind="bar",stacked=True,ax=ax,
    color=['#c0392b','#2980b9','#bdc3c7'],legend=True,rot=0)
for i,(c,n) in enumerate(zip(orth.index,orth.n)): ax.text(i,103,f"n={n}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("% of orthologs"); ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_title("Residue at the +1 position across ADGRA2 orthologs",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(title="+1 residue",fontsize=8)
plt.show()
print("\nsaved: provenance/adgra2_gps_pssm_scan_human_agpcrs.csv")
